title: The language of the press
summary: Read Turkish headlines, which drop the copula and choose their tense with care; follow who said what in a report (*belirtti*, *ifade etti*, *kaydetti*, *-mAsI bekleniyor*); recognize the agentless passive of the news; and write dates, figures and abbreviations with the right suffix (*2026'da*, *%15'lik*, *TBMM'de*).
canDo: Read a headline and say what happened, when, and who says so
Tell a confirmed fact from a claim and an expectation in a news report
Report a statement in news style with reporting verbs and the passive
Write dates, figures, percentages and abbreviations with the right suffixes
